taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: FEIS's red baneberry review (Crane 1990, read 2026-10-15): "usually from 1 to 3 feet (4-10 dm) tall with one to several branched stems".

traits.leaf_division.note: FEIS's red baneberry review (Crane 1990, read 2026-10-15): "The leaves are alternate, two to three times compound, sharply toothed and lobed".

traits.division_order.note: FEIS's red baneberry review (Crane 1990, read 2026-10-15): leaves "two to three times compound".

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: FEIS's red baneberry review (Crane 1990, read 2026-10-15): "The leaves are alternate".

traits.inflorescence.note: FEIS's red baneberry review (Crane 1990, read 2026-10-15): "Flowers are borne in a terminal or axillary raceme".

traits.fruit_type.note: FEIS's red baneberry review (Crane 1990, read 2026-10-15): "The fruits are showy, poisonous, red or occasionally white berries".

traits.fruit_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as the FEIS review read gives no months.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as the FEIS review read gives no months.

generator.params.note: Western columbine's values, changed by hand for red baneberry: two stems with three large, twice-compound leaves each and no basal rosette, ending in a short dense raceme of small white flowers that ripens into a cluster of red berries (FEIS, Crane 1990). Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 70 cm at 4 years, the middle of FEIS's 40-100 cm (Crane 1990). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye, after FEIS's description (Crane 1990): small white petals with showy stamens (many stamens, a large centre), glossy red berries, sharply toothed leaflets.

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values
sources.licence: project contribution under the repository's terms

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the core-species expansion (2026-10-15): sizes from FEIS, drawing values from western columbine's.
